7989.title: Native shell page-scale configuration
7989.rootCauseOneLine: Native shell has no explicit scale restriction; actual WKWebView gesture behavior remains unverified.
7989.proposedFix: Obtain an iOS gesture regression first, then apply and verify a native-only scale policy without disabling browser accessibility or image gestures.
7989.caveats: Two clean configuration audits matched; no iOS runtime, native gesture reproduction, or real screenshot was available. Diagnostic and exact output are embedded in the HTML. No fix PR is safe under the reproduction gate.
